source.title: Active avoidance learning requires prefrontal suppression of amygdala-mediated defensive reactions.

confidence_rationale: The canonical paper the SD-059 title cites. Lesion + pharmacological inactivation directly establish the ilPFC->CeA freeze-SUPPRESSION interface, which is exactly the half SD-059 says exists but is insufficient. It supports SD-059's premise (suppression is a distinct, real mechanism) while its own data contain no directed-escape action-credit signal -- the gap SD-059 fills. High source quality (causal manipulations, double dissociation); mapping is to the premise rather than to the added credit table, so not maxed.
failure_signatures: ilPFC inactivation increased freezing and decreased avoidance but the study provides no evidence for a positively-reinforced, action-specific escape response -- consistent with SD-059's claim that the suppression pathway alone does not compute the escape direction.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Instrumental active avoidance recruits infralimbic prefrontal cortex to inhibit central-amygdala-mediated Pavlovian defensive reactions (freezing), producing a robust, context-general suppression of freezing; ilPFC and CeA hold two opposing memory traces.
mapping.ree_translation: This is the freeze-SUPPRESSION half that REE already owns as MECH-357/SD-058 (the ilPFC avoidance_efficacy gate). SD-059's thesis is that this suppression interface only releases the no-op/freeze brake and 'does NOT compute the escape direction'; the paper supports the existence and causal necessity of that suppression interface while supplying no directed-escape action-credit, which is precisely the unwired gap SD-059 adds via the affordance-indexed credit table.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paper evidences the SUPPRESSION half (MECH-357), not the per-first-action-class relief/safety credit table that is the novel content of SD-059/MECH-358; treating it as direct support for the credit table would over-map. It is rodent lesion/inactivation data, so the action-credit absence is an absence-of-evidence, not a measured negative.
mapping.source_context: Rats, signaled (Sidman/platform) active avoidance; electrolytic lesions, muscimol inactivation, anisomycin protein-synthesis inhibition; c-Fos.

confidence_components.notes: Causal manipulations in the canonical paradigm; transfer risk from rodent suppression circuit to a V3 arithmetic regulator is moderate. Mapping is to the premise/gap, not the added mechanism.
